evidence.claim: The trial loaded the agent-behavior and aria-nbv-context skill guides.
The trial read reviewed intent, the accepted scoped target-state specification, and relevant owner-routing material.
The trial inspected docs/AGENTS.md, the Typst style owner, and the related specification for thesis-code link ownership.
The trial verified the representative Typst contract by compiling docs/typst/thesis/sections/01-introduction.typ with draft links disabled and a code reference input, and checked checkout state.
The trial checked git status and reported a clean checkout.
